questions.stem: Which of the following is the correct order of layers of epidermis from deep to superficial?
questions.stemHtml: Which of the following is the correct order of layers of epidermis from deep to superficial?

options.label: A
options.text: Stratum basale, Stratum granulosum, Stratum spinosum, Stratum corneum

options.label: B
options.text: Stratum basale, Stratum spinosum, Stratum granulosum, Stratum corneum

options.label: C
